clips.title: The story
paras: In Auberdine, Tharnariun Treetender watches Darkshore’s wilds for signs of sickness. The night elf naturalist studies the corruption spreading through local plants and animals, seeking ways to protect them.

In Auberdine, Tharnariun Treetender watches the woods beyond the port. Hostile satyrs and foul shoreline washaways threaten the village, but his work centers on the natural world around it. He believes neglecting nature invites ruin, so he studies the decline of the local woods and searches for ways to fight the sickness spreading across the forest floor.
